messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need some help managing my accounts. I have two checking accounts with you — a Green Account and a Silver Account — and honestly, having two checking accounts is getting confusing. First, I want to close my Green Account and just keep the Silver one going forward. The Green Account is empty — I already moved the money out. And second, I’ve also been meaning to open a savings account.

{
  "message": "I can help with that. To close an account or open a new one I’ll need to verify your identity first. Please provide your full name (or user ID) and any 2 of the following 4 items: date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), email, phone number, or mailing address. Once you provide those we’ll proceed with closing the Green checking account and opening a savings account. 

Also: 
- Confirm you want the Green checking account permanently closed (you stated it’s empty). 
- Tell me any preferences for the new savings account (e.g., link it to your Silver checking, a nickname, or if you want a standard savings). 

If you’d rather speak to a human instead of verifying here, say so and I’ll transfer you."
}
